summary: Completed focused Google auth testing with synthetic MongoDB sessions. Auth API, cookie/Bearer validation, expiry, logout deletion, CORS, build, unauthenticated gating, origin-based redirect, callback fragment clearing, mobile workspace access, and logout all passed.

critical.issue: Workspace APIs do not require current_user authentication; unauthenticated clients can call them directly despite the UI being gated.

minor.issue: Logout deletes only the cookie token. A caller authenticated via Authorization Bearer can receive ok=true while its session remains in user_sessions.

action_items: Protect all authenticated workspace endpoints with current_user (or an equivalent dependency) before exposing learner data and tutor actions.
Update logout to read the Bearer token when no session cookie is present, then delete that session too.
critical_code_review_comments: The UI auth gate is not an API authorization boundary: every dashboard, source, tutor, assessment, evaluation, and study-plan route currently accepts anonymous requests.
The auth session update path changes name/picture/last_sign_in_at but does not refresh google_id for an existing email record; verify intended identity reconciliation behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (auth flow assertions passed; prior non-auth mobile navigation findings remain)

seed_data_creation: Created and removed TEST_auth_user and TEST_browser_auth_user synthetic users/sessions in local test_database; no mocked APIs were used.
test_credentials: No credentials supplied; real Google account was not automated per auth_testing.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth API and browser flows are covered. Retest endpoint authorization and Bearer logout after fixes; prior iteration still has source persistence, mobile navigation, tutor loading, and dynamic citation findings.
rca of the issue: Frontend AuthRouter hides workspace until /api/auth/me succeeds, but backend workspace handlers have no authentication dependency, so direct API access bypasses the UI gate. Logout reads only request.cookies.get('session_token'), leaving Bearer-created sessions active.
